JOINT LETTER MOTION for Extension of Time to Amend Complaint addressed to Judge Jeannette A. Vargas from Plaintiffs and Defendants dated 10-20-2026. Document filed by Plaintiffs.

ORDER granting 128 Letter Motion for Leave to File Document. The Court grants the Government's request to file a reply brief. The reply brief shall address the Government's position regarding the effect of the Court's vacatur of the Policy on visas that were refused because of the Policy between January 14, 2026 and August 21, 2026. This shall include an explanation of whether, under existing regulations and policies, those visa applications will undergo additional processing or reprocessing now that the Policy is no longer in effect. The reply brief shall not exceed 1,250 words. The letter shall be due by 5:00 pm on Friday, October 23, 2026. The Clerk of Court is directed to terminate ECF No. 128. SO ORDERED. (Signed by Judge Jeannette A. Vargas on 10/20/2026) (jjc) (Entered: 10/20/2026)
